content: Multi-variate Bernoulli (MVB) and multinomial naive Bayes (MNB) are two generative models based on the naive Bayes assumption. In other words, they assume that all attributes (e.g., the frequency of each word, the presence or absence of a word) of each text are independent of each other given the context of the class BIBREF11 .
